response.sql: WITH filtered_standings AS (SELECT driverId, points, wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0), driver_avgs AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) as avg_points, AVG(wins) as avg_wins FROM filtered_standings GROUP BY driverId), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as mean_wins FROM driver_avgs), with_diff AS (SELECT da.driverId, da.avg_points, da.avg_wins, da.avg_wins - om.mean_wins as difference FROM driver_avgs da CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE om.mean_wins IS NOT NULL) SELECT driverId, avg_points, avg_wins, difference FROM with_diff ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10
